title: Friday Chit Chat 5 with Colin Anderson

sentences.en: Hello, welcome to another Friday Chit Chat.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到又一期的周五闲聊。

sentences.en: Hi, we have a fun little guest in the studio with us.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我们今天的工作室里来了一位有趣的小嘉宾。

sentences.en: So we have Sam, we have Cassie,
sentences.zh: 我们有萨姆，有卡西，

sentences.en: and then we have Colin who worked with us at Earwolf.
sentences.zh: 还有曾在 Earwolf 和我们一起工作的科林。

sentences.en: Colin, say hi.
sentences.zh: 科林，打个招呼吧。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: Colin's visiting and we have forced him to come in the studio
sentences.zh: 科林来串门，我们强行把他拉进了工作室

sentences.en: and be on mic with you today.
sentences.zh: 今天陪你们一起用麦克风聊聊天。

sentences.en: Yeah, I hate being on microphone.
sentences.zh: 对，我讨厌用麦克风。

sentences.en: I like listening to podcasts, watching podcasts,
sentences.zh: 我喜欢听播客，看播客，

sentences.en: not talking on podcasts.
sentences.zh: 而不是在播客里说话。

sentences.en: You're going to do just fine.
sentences.zh: 你会表现得很棒的。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Angela, you said you have a share.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，你说你有东西要分享。

sentences.en: Well, I do.
sentences.zh: 对，我是有。

sentences.en: Okay, so a while back, there was an article in The New Yorker,
sentences.zh: 好啦，不久前，《纽约客》上有一篇文章，

sentences.en: and it was called, Why Do We Still Love The Office?
sentences.zh: 它的标题是：《为什么我们依然热爱〈办公室〉？》

sentences.en: And it had an illustration for the article.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章还配有一幅插图。

sentences.en: It's of everyone in the bullpen.
sentences.zh: 画的是大办公室里的所有人。

sentences.en: And Jenna, I loved it because right front and center
sentences.zh: 珍娜，我很喜欢它，因为正前方正中央

sentences.en: are Pam and Angela.
sentences.zh: 就是帕姆和安吉拉。

sentences.en: Angela even has one of her cats.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉甚至还带着她的一只猫。

sentences.en: I'm going to put this in our stories.
sentences.zh: 我一会儿把它发到我们的快拍里。

sentences.en: Do you see that?
sentences.zh: 你看到了吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 看到了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: Well, I just kind of became obsessed with it because,
sentences.zh: 总之，我有点对它着迷了，因为，

sentences.en: I mean, our two characters are the front two characters,
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们两个角色成了最前方的两个角色，

sentences.en: and that so rarely happens for us in any kind of artwork
sentences.zh: 这在任何为《办公室》创作的艺术作品中

sentences.en: that's done for the office.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说都是极其罕见的。

sentences.en: So I found the artist, and his name is Max Dalton,
sentences.zh: 所以我找到了这位艺术家，他叫马克斯·道尔顿，

sentences.en: and he does a lot of illustrations.
sentences.zh: 他创作了大量插画。

sentences.en: And I DM'd him on Instagram, and I said,
sentences.zh: 我在 Instagram 上给他发了私信，我说，

sentences.en: is there any way I can get a copy of this drawing?
sentences.zh: 我有没有什么办法能弄到一张这幅画的复制品？

sentences.en: I love it so much.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢它了。

sentences.en: And he was like, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，当然可以。

sentences.en: And he sent me this note.
sentences.zh: 他还给我寄了这张便条。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: Dear Angela,
sentences.zh: 亲爱的安吉拉，

sentences.en: here's two copies of my illustration of the office,
sentences.zh: 这是两份我画的《办公室》插画复制品，

sentences.en: because I asked if I could have one for you, too.
sentences.zh: 因为我问过是否也能为你留一份。

sentences.en: Stop it.
sentences.zh: 别开玩笑了。

sentences.en: And he said,
sentences.zh: 接着他说，

sentences.en: as you know,
sentences.zh: 如你所知，

sentences.en: the illustration was made only for an article in The New Yorker,
sentences.zh: 这幅插画只是为《纽约客》的一篇文章创作的，

sentences.en: so it's unfortunately quite small.
sentences.zh: 所以遗憾的是它非常小。

sentences.en: And then he put in parentheses,
sentences.zh: 然后他在括号里写道，

sentences.en: woulda that's what she said apply here?
sentences.zh: “这算不算‘她说的’这句话适用的时候呢？”

sentences.en: And then he wrote on to say,
sentences.zh: 接着他又写道，

sentences.en: I hope that's not too disappointing.
sentences.zh: 希望这不会太令人失望。

sentences.en: Thanks to you and Jenna and the rest of the cast
sentences.zh: 谢谢你、珍娜以及剧组的其他成员

sentences.en: for all the hilarious moments.
sentences.zh: 带给我们所有欢乐的时刻。

sentences.en: Love, Max.
sentences.zh: 爱你的，马克斯。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 噢，我的天哪。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And now you and I each have one.
sentences.zh: 现在你和我各有一个了。

sentences.en: I love that lady.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这位女士了。

sentences.en: That is so sweet.
sentences.zh: 这太贴心了。

sentences.en: It's so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 它太美了。

sentences.en: I love his drawing.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢他的画。

sentences.en: I just think it captures everything.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得它捕捉到了一切。

sentences.en: And you even have prison Mike on the computer screen.
sentences.zh: 而且你的电脑屏幕上甚至还有“监狱迈克”。

sentences.en: So I'll share that in my stories.
sentences.zh: 所以我会在我的快拍里分享这个。

sentences.en: But I just thought I had to give Max a thank you here on the podcast,
sentences.zh: 但我只是觉得我必须在这里的播客中向马克斯表达感谢，

sentences.en: because that was so wonderful of him.
sentences.zh: 因为他真是太好了。

sentences.en: Do you know about the artist that goes to thrift stores and buys paintings,
sentences.zh: 你知道那个去旧货店买画的艺术家吗，

sentences.en: and then he paints people into them?
sentences.zh: 然后他在画里画上了人？

sentences.en: Like he repurposes thrift art?
sentences.zh: 就像他改造旧货艺术品一样？

sentences.en: Okay, so he took some thrifted painting of The Last Supper,
sentences.zh: 好吧，他拿了一幅旧货店买来的《最后的晚餐》的画，

sentences.en: and he painted The Office into it.
sentences.zh: 然后他把《办公室》画了进去。

sentences.en: So like on the table, there's like a stapler in Jell-O,
sentences.zh: 所以在桌子上，有像果冻里的订书机这样的东西，

sentences.en: but then all of our characters are in the painting.
sentences.zh: 然后我们所有的角色都在画里面。

sentences.en: And I saw his reel as he was doing it,
sentences.zh: 我看到他制作时的短视频了，

sentences.en: and I made a comment where I said,
sentences.zh: 我留了个言说，

sentences.en: oh, my gosh, I would love this.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪，我太想要这个了。

sentences.en: This is amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: And he, I guess, wrote me back and said, you can have it.
sentences.zh: 我猜他回信对我说，你可以拥有它。

sentences.en: But I guess I didn't see his message in time,
sentences.zh: 但我想我没及时看到他的消息，

sentences.en: and he ended up selling it.
sentences.zh: 结果他把它卖了。

sentences.en: Aw.
sentences.zh: 啊。

sentences.en: Bummer.
sentences.zh: 太遗憾了。

sentences.en: But his stuff is really cool.
sentences.zh: 但他的作品真的很酷。

sentences.en: It's really fun.
sentences.zh: 真的很有趣。

sentences.en: This in nowhere is of the same magnitude of that really cool piece of art passing you by.
sentences.zh: 这绝对无法和那件你错过的超酷艺术品相提并论。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But do you guys remember when I found out that there's a mustard wine by Grey Poupon?
sentences.zh: 但是你们还记得我发现灰 poupon 有一款芥末酒的时候吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 记得。

sentences.en: It's a long time ago for podcast listeners.
sentences.zh: 对播客听众来说是很久以前的事了。

sentences.en: Well, I guess Grey Poupon reached out to us to send us their mustard wine,
sentences.zh: 好吧，我猜灰 poupon 联系我们说要给我们寄他们的芥末酒，

sentences.en: and I never saw the DM.
sentences.zh: 而我从来没看到那条私信。

sentences.en: And you missed it.
sentences.zh: 而你错过了。

sentences.en: And now I can't find it.
sentences.zh: 现在我找不到了。

sentences.en: I don't know where it's like buried in the DMs.
sentences.zh: 我不知道它被埋在私信的哪个地方。

sentences.en: Jenna, that guy's name is Tyler Turnbull.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，那个家伙的名字叫泰勒·特恩布尔。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you, Sam.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你，萨姆。

sentences.en: Tyler Turnbull.
sentences.zh: 泰勒·特恩布尔。

sentences.en: Tyler Turnbull.
sentences.zh: 泰勒·特恩布尔。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, we'll share about him in our stories.
sentences.zh: 我们会把他的情况分享到我们的快拍里。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I hope Grey Poupon reaches back out to you.
sentences.zh: 我也希望 Grey Poupon 能再次联系你。

sentences.en: Yeah, Grey Poupon.
sentences.zh: 对，Grey Poupon。

sentences.en: It's not too late.
sentences.zh: 现在还不算晚。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Come back over.
sentences.zh: 回来吧。

sentences.en: We'll try your mustard wine.
sentences.zh: 我们会试试你的芥末酒。

sentences.en: Well, on this same subject, you know, after Lindsay Broad was on our podcast and she talked
sentences.zh: 说起这个，你知道的，在 Lindsay Broad 上了我们的播客之后，她谈到了

sentences.en: about True Fru and how much she loves the chocolate-covered fruit from True Fru.
sentences.zh: True Fru，以及她有多喜欢 True Fru 的巧克力包裹水果。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: They sent her a whole box of True Fru.
sentences.zh: 他们给她寄了一整箱 True Fru。

sentences.en: That's awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: She is so delighted.
sentences.zh: 她高兴极了。

sentences.en: I was texting with her about it.
sentences.zh: 我正和她发短信聊这事呢。

sentences.en: She just texted me a photo of a giant box of True Fru, and I was like, what is happening?
sentences.zh: 她刚给我发了一张装着巨大一箱 True Fru 的照片，当时我就想，这是怎么回事？

sentences.en: And how did this happen?
sentences.zh: 这事是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: How did this occur?
sentences.zh: 怎么会这样？

sentences.en: This is a really hard segue, but as you were saying that, all I could think of is like,
sentences.zh: 这个转折有点生硬，但当你说那些的时候，我脑子里唯一的想法就是，

sentences.en: there's got to be something, Cullen, you can take to help pass your kidney.
sentences.zh: 卡伦，肯定有什么东西是你吃了能帮排出肾结石的。

sentences.en: Oh, no!
sentences.zh: 噢，不！

sentences.en: Oh, no!
sentences.zh: 噢，不！

sentences.en: Oh, no!
sentences.zh: 噢，不！

sentences.en: Some sort of chocolate-covered fruit to help you pass her kidney stone?
sentences.zh: 某种巧克力包裹的水果能帮她排出肾结石？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's all I could think of.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里全是这个。

sentences.en: I'm so sorry.
sentences.zh: 我太抱歉了。

sentences.en: We're actually surprised you made it in today.
sentences.zh: 其实我们很惊讶你今天能来。

sentences.en: I mean, Jenna and I have been texting you, and you shared with us, and you said it's okay
sentences.zh: 我是说，珍娜和我一直在给你发短信，你跟我们分享了，而且你说

sentences.en: to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 可以聊这个。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，完全可以。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You have a kidney stone.
sentences.zh: 你长了肾结石。

sentences.en: Yeah, we were meant to be meeting Monday, and I called in sick from urgent care.
sentences.zh: 对，我们本来打算周一开会，我在急诊中心请了病假。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: But I sent you an article, Cullen, and this is true.
sentences.zh: 但我给你发了一篇文章，卡伦，千真万确。

sentences.en: Guys, this is not like internet nonsense.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，这不是网上那种瞎扯。

sentences.en: Like, this isn't like some reel on the gram.
sentences.zh: 这可不是 Ins 上的那种短视频。

sentences.en: This is a real article where they found that people with kidney stones, if they ride the
sentences.zh: 这是一篇真正的文章，上面发现有肾结石的人如果去坐

sentences.en: roller coaster Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, they pass their kidney stones.
sentences.zh: 巨雷山铁路过山车，就能排出肾结石。

sentences.en: Is it something about how it twists and turns?
sentences.zh: 是因为它那些七弯八绕的轨迹吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: Colin, did you go to Disneyland yesterday?
sentences.zh: 科林，你昨天去迪士尼乐园了吗？

sentences.en: I didn't.
sentences.zh: 我没去。

sentences.en: I wondered if I could, like, claim it back on my health care, though.
sentences.zh: 不过我在想，我能不能把它当医疗费用报销呢。

sentences.en: It seemed like it would be an excellent, like, deduction.
sentences.zh: 感觉这会是一笔绝佳的医疗抵扣。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Medically speaking, you need to go.
sentences.zh: 从医学角度来讲，你得去一趟。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Do you have an HSA card?
sentences.zh: 你有健康储蓄账户卡吗？

sentences.en: Are you in pain?
sentences.zh: 你觉得痛吗？

sentences.en: Anything even though?
sentences.zh: 虽然有什么不对劲吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, a little bit.
sentences.zh: 对，有一点。

sentences.en: I just took some more painkillers.
sentences.zh: 我刚又吃了一些止痛药。

sentences.en: I'm so sorry.
sentences.zh: 真的很抱歉。

sentences.en: But it seems to, like, come and go.
sentences.zh: 但它好像是一阵一阵的。

sentences.en: And it's particularly bad overnight because I'm one of those tornado sleepers that just
sentences.zh: 而且半夜特别严重，因为我是那种睡觉像龙卷风一样

sentences.en: keeps spinning around.
sentences.zh: 转个不停的人。

sentences.en: I'm like that too.
sentences.zh: 我也是这样。

sentences.en: And really what I need to do is just lay still.
sentences.zh: 其实我真正需要做的是躺着别动。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 噢，不是吧。

sentences.en: You need to get a cat, and then the cat will sleep on you, and then you can't turn.
sentences.zh: 你需要养只猫，然后猫就会睡在你身上，这样你就动不了了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Kessie, that's your answer to everything.
sentences.zh: 凯茜，你什么事都用这个答案。

sentences.en: And that's deductible, right?
sentences.zh: 而且那个可以报销医疗费吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Colin, I pulled up the article.
sentences.zh: 科林，我把那篇文章找出来了。

sentences.en: I want everyone to know this information, and I really want to go to Disneyland with you.
sentences.zh: 我想让大家都知道这个信息，而且我真的很想跟你一起去迪士尼乐园。

sentences.en: It says that it has a 70% success rate, but not every roller coaster works.
sentences.zh: 上面说它的成功率是百分之七十，但并不是每过山车都有用。

sentences.en: That in particular, the Big Thunder Mountain Railroad is the most successful.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，巨雷山过山车是最成功的。

sentences.en: This group of doctors, they took a 3D model of a hollow kidney containing three kidney stones
sentences.zh: 这群医生，他们把一个包含三颗肾结石的中空肾脏三维模型

sentences.en: on the ride in a backpack 20 times, and when they sat in the very last car of the railroad,
sentences.zh: 放在背包里坐了二十次过山车，当他们坐在过山车的最后一节车厢时，

sentences.en: like, you have to sit in the laSt.
sentences.zh: 就是说，你必须坐在最末端。

sentences.en: Don't sit in the front.
sentences.zh: 不要坐前面。

sentences.en: If you sit in the back, there's a 64% passage rate.
sentences.zh: 如果你坐在后面，排石率是百分之六十四。

sentences.en: If you sit in the front, there's only a 16% success rate.
sentences.zh: 如果你坐在前面，成功率只有百分之十六。

sentences.en: But they expanded their study, and they used even more kidney models.
sentences.zh: 但他们扩大了研究范围，使用了更多的肾脏模型。

sentences.en: And the second time they did it, when they sat in the back, it was a 70% success rate.
sentences.zh: 他们第二次做的时候，坐在后面，成功率达到了百分之七十。

sentences.en: They said, in all, we used 174 kidney stones of varying shapes, sizes, and weights to see
sentences.zh: 他们说，总共用了 174 颗形状、大小和重量各不相同的肾脏模型来测试

sentences.en: if each model worked on the same ride.
sentences.zh: 每个模型在同一个过山车上是否都管用。

sentences.en: And Big Thunder Mountain Railroad was the only one that worked.
sentences.zh: 而巨雷山过山车是唯一管用的。

sentences.en: They tried Space Mountain and Aerosmith's Rock and Roller Coaster, but those failed.
sentences.zh: 他们试过太空山和史密斯飞船摇滚过山车，但那些都失败了。

sentences.en: He said it has something to do with the twists and turns.
sentences.zh: 他说这跟急转弯有关。

sentences.en: And he said, if you have a kidney stone but are otherwise healthy and meet the requirements
sentences.zh: 他还说，如果你有肾结石但身体健康状况良好并且符合游乐设施的

sentences.en: of the ride, you should try it.
sentences.zh: 要求，你应该去试试。

sentences.en: Sounds like a great doctor's day out, right?
sentences.zh: 听起来像是医生们很棒的郊游日对吧？

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: To convince you at university that you should go to Disneyland.
sentences.zh: 在大学里说服你该去迪士尼乐园。

sentences.en: And just ride this roller coaster how many times?
sentences.zh: 然后到底要坐多少次这个过山车？

sentences.en: And we'll need to try them all as well just to make sure it works.
sentences.zh: 而且我们还得把所有的都试一遍，以确保它真的管用。

sentences.en: Also, the Aerosmith one is in Orlando.
sentences.zh: 还有，史密斯飞船那个在奥兰多。

sentences.en: So they got the budget to fly to Florida to test their experiment.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有预算飞到佛罗里达去测试他们的实验。

sentences.en: I think they actually only tested this in Florida.
sentences.zh: 我想他们其实只在佛罗里达测试过这个。

sentences.en: So I do wonder, Colin.
sentences.zh: 所以我在想，科林。

sentences.en: You are sh**ed out of luck there.
sentences.zh: 你在那儿可就彻底没戏了。

sentences.en: I mean, I think Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, isn't that the same in Disney World and Disneyland?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，巨雷山过山车，迪士尼世界和迪士尼乐园里的不是一样的吗？

sentences.en: Unless humidity is a factor.
